summary: Tested new check-in pricing logic with room-guest mapping. Fixed critical bug where room assignment section was not rendering (check-in button was not calling openCheckInDialog). All backend tests pass (8/8). Frontend UI verified working with room assignment, Valid ID toggles, and Def Civ rate calculation.

ui_bugs.issue: Check-in button was directly setting showCheckIn state instead of calling openCheckInDialog, causing roomGuestMapping to not be initialized

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Line 1135 in Bookings.jsx - Changed onClick handler from direct state setting to openCheckInDialog(booking) to properly initialize roomGuestMapping
context_for_next_testing_agent: New check-in pricing logic fully implemented and tested. Key features: 1) Dependent ID Ser No field in Family Members section, 2) Room-Wise Guest Assignment section with per-room guest checkboxes, 3) Valid ID/Valid Dependent ID toggles that affect charge category, 4) Def Civ rates applied when any guest in a room lacks valid ID, 5) Bill Summary shows per-room charges breakdown. Backend correctly recalculates room_rent_total based on room_guest_mapping during check-in.
seed_data_creation: Created test bookings: BK0012 (TEST_UI_CheckIn) for UI testing, plus multiple TEST_Pricing_* bookings for backend API testing
